scope: runtime resource limit only; no changes to search algorithm, workload, buffers, deadlines, treatment definitions, seeds, acceptance gates, or simulation parameters
logical_cpu_plan: eight concurrent single-threaded simulators; four logical CPUs remain available to the OS/SSH; no CPU affinity restriction
CPU_priority: nice=0; raises priority relative to old nice=19, but negative nice requires sudo and was unavailable non-interactively
IO_priority: best-effort class, priority 0 (old run used priority 7)
memory_guard: monitor available RAM/swap and system responsiveness; if memory pressure becomes sustained, pause after a cell and resume with --jobs 6 or 4; never raise beyond eight in this campaign
resume_behavior: fsync ledger/checkpoint; keep all ledger-committed results; archive and rerun incomplete uncommitted attempts
